title: INDIA bloc announces protest in Delhi over voting rights
seoTitle: Delhi INDIA bloc protest over voting rights

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and the functioning of the CEC.
tea.want: Demanding free and fair electoral processes and systems.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Congress and the INDIA bloc announced plans to stage a major protest in Delhi on October 12.

summary: The Congress-led opposition INDIA bloc has announced plans to stage a major protest in Delhi on Monday, October 12. The demonstration is part of an ongoing campaign to safeguard voting rights and address alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, which reportedly saw over 13 crore deletions. Protesters are also scrutinising Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. According to Congress general secretary KC Venugopal, the opposition will continue its agitation until the electoral process becomes completely free and fair. The announcement follows recent police actions and detentions of several political leaders and activists in Delhi.
demands: Make the electoral process and system free and fair
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Congress announced the opposition INDIA bloc will hold a major protest in Delhi on Oct 12 over voting rights.
